description: This file defines a Dashboard component for a React application, which displays financial summaries such as total budget, total spent, remaining amount, and visual charts (BarByCategory, CategoryPie, BudgetVsSpend) related to expenses and categories. It uses React hooks and utility functions to process and display expense data.

classes.name: Stat
classes.description: A React component that displays a title and a value within styled card UI elements.

methods.name: Dashboard()
methods.description: Main React functional component that assembles the expense dashboard with statistical summaries and charts.

methods.name: Stat({ title, value })
methods.description: Reusable component for rendering a statistic with a title and value.
